title: Environment Variables [What's in PATH?]
description:
# What's in your PATH?
Your PATH has several default directories. Each has a purpose:

- `/usr/local/bin` - programs YOU installed (brew, npm, lhc)
- `/usr/bin` - system programs installed by your package manager
- `/bin` - essential programs (ls, cp, mv, cat, echo)
- `/usr/sbin` - system admin programs (not for regular users)
- `/sbin` - essential admin programs (shutdown, mount)

### The pattern:
- `bin` = regular user programs
- `sbin` = admin programs
- `/usr/local/` = stuff you installed
- `/usr/` = stuff the system installed
- `/` = essential stuff the OS needs to boot
